:::{#exm-score-equation}
#### Score equation of a Bernoulli sample

For $n$ [independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt)
[Bernoulli](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-bernoulli)
[observations](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-observation) with $r = \sumin \outvar_\iobs$ successes,
the score is $\sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \prob)/\paren{\prob(1 - \prob)} = (r - n\prob)/\paren{\prob(1-\prob)}$
(summing [Bernoulli score](#thm-bernoulli-score) over the observations),
so for $0 < r < n$ the score equation $(r - n\prob)/\paren{\prob(1-\prob)} = 0$
has the single solution $\prob = r/n$.
:::
